prompt: From lower down the steps on a 100mm lens, the night street gone to soft blue behind, a young Black preacher of about 30, plain dark suit and white shirt with a narrow tie, clean-shaven oval face, wide-set eyes, close-cropped hair. He stands on the stone steps of a soup kitchen, front-on, hands open low at his sides, singing plainly with no showmanship. A warm lamp over the door lights his face and mouth from above and in front. Out of focus behind him along the wall, a long breadline of men in coats and flat caps stands in cold blue dark, breath showing. Full frame, no bars. Thanks.
